docs.description: Checkbox cell for a selectable Table row. 2 variants: title-row (false, true) — true is the header cell that selects all rows and supports the indeterminate state. Internal building block of Row and Table; not for use outside a table.

rules.reason: A Table row's select cell, as the description says: a SOLAR Checkbox, centred in its 40px cell, that selects its row, or in the header row every row (checked, unchecked or mixed, where some are). Bespoke on both platforms, drawn with the shared layer helpers; a cell to a screen reader inside a Row, the Checkbox named for what it selects. Whether the row is selected is the caller's, as the description leaves selection state to the table's owner.
A prop in code is one word; title-row=true is the header row's cell, as Column Item's title=true is its header (`header`).
